calculation.title: Comparable listings
calculation.detail: Live, verified listings within 3 km of this one in Vijay Nagar, with the same 2 BHK and a similar size to 1100 sqft: 12 for sale, 6 on rent.

calculation.title: Price comparison
calculation.detail: ₹5,455 per sqft against a median of ₹5,623 across 12 comparable listings (similar 2 BHK homes within 3 km).

calculation.title: Rental yield
calculation.detail: Weighted median rent of 6 comparable rentals (₹25k/month); closer and more recently listed ones count for more. Gross yield: annual rent ₹3 L ÷ price ₹60 L × 100 = 5.0%. Net yield: annual rent less ₹55k of expenses, ÷ price × 100 = 4.1%.

calculation.title: Outliers
calculation.detail: Values far outside the middle half of the sample are dropped before the median is taken, so one mistyped listing cannot move the figures.

calculation.title: Locality trend
calculation.detail: Locality price history is not recorded yet, so a yearly trend cannot be measured from DigiNiwas listings.

calculation.title: Data confidence
calculation.detail: Each figure is rated High, Medium or Low by how much close, own-market data it rests on (price comparison High, rental yield Medium, locality trend Low). Scored 3, 2 and 1 and weighted 50% price comparison, 30% rental yield, 20% locality trend, they average 2.3 out of 3: 2.5 or more is High, 1.75 or more Medium, anything lower Low.

disclaimer: Estimates are based on available listings and locality data. Actual rent and property value may vary.
